messages:
Noah - sales: Help needed for POC with FinEdge. They report streaming failures when their corporate SSO/NTLM proxy is in path. Both TS & Python clients drop after ~12-16s with ECONNRESET. Happens for interactive chat streams.

Ivy - solutions: Which SDK versions? Any stack traces they can paste? Also do they use desktop app or server-side agent for SSO?

Noah - sales: TS v1.4.3, Python v1.4.3. They use a Windows WinHTTP proxy (SSO agent does NTLM/Negotiate). Stack trace from browser relay: 
```
2026-03-21T08:14:02Z ERROR socket hang up after 14.6s
Error: socket hang up
    at TLSSocket.onConnectEnd (node:_tls_wrap:1429:16)
```
Python shows: `requests.exceptions.ChunkedEncodingError: (\"Connection broken: IncompleteRead(0 bytes read)\",)`. 

Rahul - eng: Pattern is similar to other corp-proxy cases but NTLM/SSO can add extra round-trips and break long-lived h2 streams if the proxy reauths or tears down idle streams. Do we know if the proxy performs re-auth mid-stream?

Noah - sales: They said the proxy sometimes issues 407 and re-negotiates auth on long connections.

Sofie - infra: On our side the stream for req-id fe-77b emitted tokens for several minutes; we didn't close. That suggests intermediate device resets the TCP or sends RST_STREAM. NTLM reauth inducing a new 407 could cause the client to close.

Ivy - solutions: Quick mitigations to ask customer: 1) Force HTTP/1.1 (some NTLM proxies handle h1 chunked better), 2) enable client keepalive pings to prevent proxy idle/reauth, 3) exempt api.redwood.ai from reauth if their proxy allows it.

Rahul - eng: Config snippets: TS SDK env toggle `REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1=1`. Also increase keepalive: `streamingKeepaliveMs: 45000`. Example: 
```js
process.env.REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1 = '1';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, streamingKeepaliveMs: 45000 });
```
Python: `export REDWOOD_HTTP_VERSION=1` and set socket/read timeout to 60s.

Sofie - infra: We'll add telemetry filter for `x-rw-stream: 1` so support can quickly find long-lived streams. I'll file infra ticket.

Ivy - solutions: Also give them curl tests to diagnose: 
```
# HTTP/2 test (likely to show cutout)
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream

# Force http1.1 (should keep streaming if proxy is reauthing)
curl -v --http1.1 --no-keepalive -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```
And ask them to check proxy logs for 407s or NTLM challenges around the timeframe.

Noah - sales: They ran the http1.1 test, stream stayed open ~3 minutes. They confirmed proxy shows occasional 407s tied to the earlier failures.

Rahul - eng: That confirms reauth as likely root cause. Workaround is fine for POC. For production recommend either: direct egress, a Dedicated route, or proxy rule to bypass reauth for our endpoints.

Sofie - infra: I'll add an internal blurb for on-call: if you see ECONNRESET ~10-20s + server-side continued output, ask about NTLM/SSO proxies and recommend REDWOOD_FORCE_HTTP1 and keepalive.

sec-bot: Security note: customer asked about TLS fingerprinting. Confirmed: Redwood uses cloud-provider TLS defaults; no custom TLS fingerprinting.

Ivy - solutions: Next steps: 1) provide step-by-step email with env vars + curl examples, 2) offer a 7-day Dedicated eval to validate without proxy, 3) provide security FAQ snippet for their questionnaire.

Noah - sales: Sending email now. POC continues with http1.1 workaround. Will reopen if they hit perf issues. :thumbsup:
